requirements.check: Exact retained transparent 64x16 sheet, four horizontal 16x16 frames; art bytes unchanged (sha256 cf101610108f5a708987dfeb1a86ae9921525464d24c19953a889e20603176dc).

requirements.name: activity
requirements.check: Readable cool-blue activity at 1x and 3x nearest on the #172336 dark panel; each frame and the sequence communicate ongoing work without a success-like pose; distinct from Ready, Retry and Paused without relying on color alone; scoped coherent treatment with the retained Ready reference.
requirements.reason: Fresh visual inspection at native 1x (browser cells and screenshot) and enlarged 3x/8x/12x nearest on #172336: cool-blue three-arc broken ring with four distinct rotation phases reads as ongoing activity, never as a check or terminal pose; transparent compositing is clean; the treatment (stepped clusters, cool-blue accent, slight highlight) is coherent with the adopted Ready baseline; in colour and in grayscale it stays distinct from Ready (check), Retry (solid ring + arrowhead) and Paused (bars).

requirements.name: integration
requirements.check: Observe the exact Working sheet in both actual consumers (statusCell and compactStatus) with four looping frames at the current authorized 150 ms each (600 ms cycle), nearest filtering and transparent compositing on the dark panel; live loop playback observed at the consumer's 3x scale, stills at 1x and 3x; 1x live playback remains unperformed.
requirements.reason: Actual renderer-integration browser execution of the real modules: both statusCell and compactStatus painted the exact served sheet with nearest filtering on the dark panel, looping frames 0-3 at the authorized 150 ms (600 ms cycle) observed live at 3x across three wraps, and 1x/3x stills verified; check.py passed with zero failures. 1x live playback was not performed (only 1x boundary samples).
